summary: XOMA Royalty Holdings Corp (Holdings) filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its merger, where Holdings became the parent of XOMA Royalty via a holding company reorganization. Merger consideration was $39.00 per share plus one contingent value right (CVR) per share, paid to holders of common stock as of the effective time (July 14, 2026). The CVRs are non-transferable, not listed or traded, and governed by a CVR Agreement with XOMA CVR Trust as sole obligor. The common stock ceased trading July 13, 2026. Watch for any CVR valuation disputes or overhang; risk-arb focuses on the $39.00 cash component and potential CVR payout.
